shomari-figures.what: Final FY2026 spending package funding most remaining federal agencies through September 30, 2026.

shomari-figures.bill: S. 1071 / FY2026 National Defense Authorization Act (final)
shomari-figures.what: Final FY2026 defense policy and funding-authorization bill (about $900 billion), carried in the House on the vehicle S. 1071.

shomari-figures.bill: H.R. 5371 (2025) Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2026 (Nov. 12 final, ended the shutdown)
shomari-figures.what: Ended the 43-day federal shutdown: funds government through Jan. 30, 2026 and three full-year spending bills.

shomari-figures.bill: H.R. 5371 (2025) Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2026 (Sept. 19 House passage)
shomari-figures.what: House-passed stopgap funding bill to keep government open through Nov. 21, 2025; stalled in the Senate and a shutdown began Oct. 1.

shomari-figures.bill: H.R. 1 (2025) One Big Beautiful Bill Act (final passage)
shomari-figures.what: The 2025 reconciliation law: extends the 2017 tax cuts, adds new tax breaks, cuts Medicaid and food-assistance spending, and raises defense and border spending and the debt limit.

shomari-figures.bill: H.R. 881 (2025) DHS Restrictions on Confucius Institutes and Chinese Entities of Concern Act
shomari-figures.what: Bars Homeland Security funds going to Confucius Institutes and entities tied to the Chinese government.
Requires documentary proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections.

shomari-figures.bill: H.R. 1968 (2025) Full-Year Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025
shomari-figures.what: Funds the federal government through September 30, 2025 at roughly prior-year levels (March 2025 stopgap).

shomari-figures.bill: H.R. 152 (2025) Federal Disaster Assistance Coordination Act
shomari-figures.what: Streamlines coordination among federal agencies delivering disaster aid (hurricane/flood recovery).
Requires federal detention of undocumented immigrants charged with theft, burglary or assault of a police officer, and lets states sue over immigration enforcement.
